answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on the WMT16 En-De task (4.5M)... We also evaluate on IATE, Wiktionary, and a newly created challenging English‑German terminology constraint test set.
answer_1.outputs: translated sentences that satisfy specified terminology constraints

answer_2.quote: We use several metrics to study the performance of different methods comprehensively. Specifically, in addition to reporting detokenized BLEU scores with sacrebleu, we also use COMET to evaluate the translation quality... we also use strict sentence-level constraint accuracy (SCA) as the metric for terminology constraint.
